skillList.skill_name: Audio device development experience on various platforms
skillList.skill_desc: Familiar with audio device development on Windows WASAPI, MAC, Android, Linux, iOS, etc.

projectList.project_desc: On Windows 11, implement the Mute/UnMute feature of ZOOM software in conjunction with the system, keeping it in real-time synchronization. It is possible to control and display the Mute status on the software and system interface, as well as respond simultaneously to control on HID and Bluetooth earphones hardware.
projectList.project_content:
1. Responsible for preliminary research of the project.
2. Responsible for project function design and development.
3. Responsible for UI function docking.

projectList.project_desc: Implement multiple conferences on a single client at the same time and switch flexibly, meeting the needs of large conferences with multiple sub-conferences. In this project, I mainly solved the problem of multiple instances unable to obtain their own playback reference signals, leading to echo that could not be processed.
projectList.project_content:
1. Implement an audio transmission mechanism between multiple conference instances on a client.
2. Responsible for adjusting the development of underlying audio part functions.
3. Responsible for testing and tuning.

projectList.project_desc: Allow interpreters of different languages to join the conference, translating the content in real-time. Users can choose a specified language channel according to the actual situation, and it is possible to implement more than 100 different language translation functions. This feature has been unanimously praised by the industry and generated hundreds of thousands of dollars in revenue for the company during a conference held by the British Prime Minister.
projectList.project_content:
1. Implement multi-channel sound control, logic functions such as lowering background sound when the interpreter speaks, etc.
2. Solve various problems encountered during actual customer use.
3. Responsible for testing and tuning.
4. Customized requirements for organizations such as the WTO during the epidemic.

projectList.project_desc: Implement the embedding of watermarks in playback sound to locate clients who secretly record, ensuring the security of the conference. This feature was initially requested by Uber and played a huge role in a conference leak involving Uber. The parsing tool I developed successfully identified the ID of the leaker.
projectList.project_content:
1. Implement the landing of watermark algorithms.
2. Develop the watermark interface client.
3. Function testing and tuning.
4. Develop a watermark parsing tool.

projectList.project_desc: Implement end-to-end communication on set-top boxes. This was a pre-research project that was not actually applied. Through this project, I became more familiar with the entire WebRTC framework and have the ability to quickly build a complete set of conference systems.
projectList.project_content:
1. Responsible for WebRTC secondary development.
2. Implement a real-time video and voice communication system on set-top boxes.
3. Function testing and tuning.
4. As a prophetic project for China Mobile, I was responsible for building the client and server alone, and simply implemented basic signaling functions, allowing the entire video conference function to basically run, achieving video and voice communication from Hangzhou to Sichuan.

projectList.project_desc: Multiple low-end VoIP network phones are the company's most profitable product series. Based on the technical solutions provided by chip manufacturers for secondary development, end-to-end network communication was achieved in the local area network.
projectList.project_content:
1. Test whether each audio module meets the actual usage requirements.
2. Participate in discussions on problem feedback and docking.
3. Participate in weekly work meetings with chip suppliers to discuss product issues.
4. Control the stability of the core function of voice quality.
5. Long-term responsibility for maintaining email communication with German and Indian suppliers to solve actual problems.

projectList.project_desc: Two Android network phone terminals are the company's core profitable products. A media framework was developed in the system, which supports audio collection, processing, playback, encoding interface, network transmission jitter processing, etc., providing support for the core VoIP business.
projectList.project_content:
1. Addition of audio modules, including encoding and decoding, AEC, AGC, noise reduction.
2. Audio debugging, DTMF, RFC2833.
3. Implemented recording function, EQ module, tone generation, rtcp, etc. using C++/C.
4. Sound debugging, including loudness, sound effects, distortion, self-excitation, etc.

aboutme.aboutme_desc: I am an expert with ten years of experience in VoIP software development, specializing in real-time voice collection, playback, and sound processing tuning. Throughout my long career, I have been committed to solving various audio issues and have developed many audio-related features using C++, such as audio watermarking and simultaneous interpretation. My passion and expertise have brought many successful projects to my team and have helped our customers achieve an excellent voice communication experience. If you are looking for an experienced VoIP software developer, I believe I would be an outstanding choice.
